name: Foldwise Bio
one_liner: AI agents that design and rank antibody variants before they reach the wet lab.
product: A multi-agent platform (structure prediction, developability scoring, liability screening) that returns ranked antibody candidates via API and a lab notebook integration.
target_customers: Discovery heads at mid-size biotechs and CROs running antibody programs
pricing_today: Not priced yet; considering per-design-campaign pricing
traction: 3 design partners running free campaigns; one reported a 4x cut in candidates sent to the lab
goals_90d: Turn design partners into paid pilots and launch self-serve credits for small labs
constraints: Customer data is confidential; many buyers require deployment in their own AWS account
